title: "07_NMDS_multivariate"
output: html_document

```{r Load packages}
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r Load data}
# Compact helper function to read raw CSVs
bee_data <- read.csv(file.path("..", "data", "cleaned", "bee_data.csv"),
           stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
           check.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}

###############################################################
# 1. Detect species columns (format: "Genus species")
###############################################################

species_cols <- names(bee_data)[
  str_detect(names(bee_data), "^[A-Z][a-z]+\\s[a-z]+")
]

cat("Species columns detected:", length(species_cols), "\n")

###############################################################
# 2. Collapse repeated visits → one row per plot
###############################################################

plot_level <- bee_data %>%
  group_by(region, site, plotID) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(species_cols), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  ungroup()

###############################################################
# 3. Convert abundances to presence/absence
###############################################################

plot_level[species_cols] <- (plot_level[species_cols] > 0) * 1

###############################################################
# 4. Extract community matrix + metadata
###############################################################

comm_matrix <- as.data.frame(plot_level[, species_cols])

meta <- plot_level %>%
  select(region, site, plotID)

###############################################################
# 5. Remove empty rows (plots with zero bees)
###############################################################

empty_rows <- rowSums(comm_matrix) == 0
cat("Empty plots removed:", sum(empty_rows), "\n")

comm_matrix <- comm_matrix[!empty_rows, ]
meta <- meta[!empty_rows, ]

###############################################################
# 6. Fit NMDS on FULL dataset once (Bray on PA = Sørensen)
###############################################################

set.seed(123)

nmds <- metaMDS(
  comm_matrix,
  distance = "bray",
  k = 2,
  trymax = 200
)

cat("NMDS stress =", nmds$stress, "\n")

###############################################################
# 7. Combine NMDS scores with metadata
###############################################################

nmds_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds, display = "sites"))
nmds_scores <- cbind(nmds_scores, meta)

###############################################################
# 8. Faceted GGplot NMDS — one panel per region
###############################################################

ggplot(nmds_scores, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, color = site)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = site), linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ region, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "NMDS — Bee Species Composition by Region (Presence/Absence)",
    subtitle = paste("NMDS Stress =", round(nmds$stress, 3),
                     "• Ellipses compare focal vs control *within each region*"),
    color = "Site Type"
  )

```
```{r}

betadisp <- betadisper(vegdist(comm_matrix, method="bray"), meta$site)
anova(betadisp)

```


```{r}
# ---- Update these variable names to match your dataset ----
env_vars <- bee_data %>%
  select(plotID, flower_richness, veg_height, bare_ground, temperature) %>%
  distinct()

# Match to plot-level samples
env_clean <- meta %>%
  left_join(env_vars, by = "plotID")

# Scale environmental variables
env_scaled <- env_clean %>%
  select(flower_richness, veg_height, bare_ground, temperature) %>%
  scale()

# db-RDA model
dbrda_model <- capscale(
  comm_matrix ~ flower_richness + veg_height + bare_ground + temperature + site,
  data = cbind(meta, env_scaled),
  distance = "bray"
)

# Significance
print(anova(dbrda_model, permutations = 999))
print(anova(dbrda_model, by = "terms", permutations = 999))

# Extract scores for plotting
dbrda_scores <- scores(dbrda_model)
site_scores  <- as.data.frame(dbrda_scores$sites) %>% cbind(meta)
species_scores <- as.data.frame(dbrda_scores$species)

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = site_scores,
             aes(CAP1, CAP2, color = site, shape = region),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_segment(data = species_scores,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = CAP1, yend = CAP2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               color = "grey40") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "db-RDA — Environmental Drivers of Bee Communities",
    x = "CAP1",
    y = "CAP2"
  )


```
